notes: Second-pass candidates compare naive fixed32 storage, pointer storage with the same calculation-local reuse, and fixed32 storage with calculation-local reuse. Existing Remaining gov fixtures already cover allocation, token cardinality, repeated claims at 1/10/100/1000, no-new-reward exit, and undelegate/withdraw/restake lifecycle; no fixture edits were required. The optimized variants keep reuse local to the current calculation or transaction, preserve absent versus explicit-zero fee tokens, and leave rewardDebt pointers unchanged.

variants.mechanism: Literal combined2 control: only the emission and protocol-fee manager accumulators use fixed-width 32-byte big-endian strings through utils.EncodeUint256/DecodeUint256; rewardDebt remains pointer-backed and resolver algorithms are unchanged.

Combined2 fixed32 storage plus calculation-local reuse: emission and protocol-fee accumulator values are encoded as fixed-width 32-byte big-endian strings, while prepared accumulator values and fee base maps are reused only within the current calculation/transaction; no persistent cache or rewardDebt representation change. Uses shared direct-limb fixed32 codec; no string-to-byte-slice decode or four temporary encoded-limb strings. Gov prepared full maps are decoded once, merged numerically and persisted without re-decoding.

Pointer-reuse control: accumulator pointer storage is retained, but the same calculation-local prepared-value/base-map reuse as the optimized binary variant separates representation and algorithm effects; GetAll returns an isolated map while values remain pointers, and rewardDebt remains unchanged.
External combined Uint-value storage with detached pointer adapters and caller clone cleanup; no local edits or repeated owner-reported package tests.
variants.external_unit_proof: User/owner reports full gov/staker and gov/staker/v1 tests passed on bac78a9; not rerun here.

comparison_limit: Pool is a combined four-field candidate and governance a combined two-field candidate. These are implementation comparisons, not independently attributable per-field deltas. The external value implementations have detached pointer adapters and their own clone cleanup; they are not an identical pure-format ablation of the pointer-reuse control.
